# iosxe_voice_class_sip_header_passthrulist (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class SIP Header Passthrulist configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_sip_header_passthrulist" "example" {
  tag                 = 100
  passthru_headers    = ["Call-Info"]
  passthru_hdr_unsupp = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip-hdr-passthrulist tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `passthru_hdr_unsupp` (Boolean) Enable the pass-thru of all unsupported headers
- `passthru_headers` (Set of String) Add hdr in the list of hdrs to be passed thru

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_sip_header_passthrulist.example "<tag>"
```
